lesson_title: Where Did the Eagle Get Its Energy?
hook_text: This fish eagle has never eaten a plant. But it runs on sunshine.
clip_script: Gariep Dam. A fish eagle cries, swoops and grabs a catfish. But where did its energy come from? The catfish ate small fish. The small fish ate tiny water animals. They ate algae, tiny green living things that catch sunlight. Sun, algae, tiny animals, small fish, catfish, eagle. Arrows point from the food to the eater. And at every step, most of the energy is used up. Billions of algae, just a few eagles.
visual_style: Whiteboard food chain building from right to left, eagle back to the Sun, then arrows flipping to point the correct way.
mood: Dramatic, like a nature documentary in reverse.
pacing: Start with the catch, trace the energy back to the Sun, then rebuild the chain forwards.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and draw a food chain from your own neighbourhood.
